what: Pin the section text panel to the screen and let it flow at only 1/3 of scroll speed. The panel sits at its home position (0) at section top + min(screen, section height − screen), and offsets up or down by the distance from there ÷ 3. It bends with skewY up to ±4° according to scroll speed (px/s ÷ 1000 × 1.2), and hides with visibility once fully off screen. For an immersive intro where section text drifts slowly over a 3D stage

options.skew: Max bend (deg), default 4 — 0 means no bend
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Text panel to flow (first child of the element if none)

note: The text panel is attached to the screen with position: fixed (fx.css). On phones and with reduced motion it just stays in the flow

from.where: shared.js frame plate (LAG 3·skewY ±4) — [data-im-frame] in the hero, four sections, ability ring, calculator and closing
